title: Settlement of Approved Northgate Protect Claims
content:
**Repair, replacement or reimbursement.** An approved claim is settled by repair where the tier repairs first and the repair estimate is no more than the tier's replacement threshold percent of the item's net price; otherwise by replacement with a new item under the tier's replacement basis, and where no such item is available by reimbursement through the tier's reimbursement method of the item's net price minus earlier settlements on that item.

**Repeat repairs.** Once the completed repairs for the same failure on that item have reached the tier's repair count, the next approved claim for the same failure on that item is settled by replacement whatever the estimate. The completed repairs counted are the repair settlements on the plan, over the whole coverage term, for the same covered order line and the same claim type as the claim being evaluated.

**Where repairs happen.** Major appliances, fitness equipment, furniture and TVs with a screen of at least the tier's smallest in-home TV screen size, in the tier's in-home service categories, are repaired in the home; other items go to depot repair with shipping under the tier's depot shipping term.

**Service fee (retired clause).** The service fee is taken from the tier's service-fee band containing the item's net price and is charged only on the claim types the tier charges a fee on; it is collected before the repair or replacement is released and never reduces liability. — *This clause is no longer in force; it is superseded by the current basis for service fees on claims.*

**Booking against the limit.** Each settlement books its value against the remaining limit of liability, and a settlement never exceeds the item's remaining share of the limit of liability. On Northgate Protect Complete Monthly no settlement may take the payouts of the rolling 12 months above the tier's rolling-12-month payout maximum; those payouts are the settlements on the plan dated within the 12 calendar months ending on the settlement date being evaluated, inclusive.

**End of a single-item plan.** Where the tier ends the plan on replacement, a replacement or reimbursement, or a settlement that leaves the remaining limit of liability at zero, ends the plan as fulfilled on the settlement date. A reimbursement is issued as a Northgate eGift Card.

**Limit and reimbursement basis (retired clause).** The limit of liability of each item follows the tier's limit-of-liability basis and every reimbursement follows the tier's reimbursement basis; a TV's screen size is read from the covered line's item description. — *This clause is no longer in force; it is superseded by the current basis for the registered limit of liability.*

## Settlement method, as a decision table

| Approved claim | Settled by |
|---|---|
| Repair estimate no more than the threshold percent of net price, fewer completed same-failure repairs than the repair count | Repair |
| Repair estimate above the threshold percent | Replacement; reimbursement where no like item is available |
| Completed same-failure repairs have reached the repair count | Replacement whatever the estimate |

*Hypothetical:* with an 80 percent threshold and a $500.00 net price, an estimate of $400.00 is repaired and an estimate of $400.01 is replaced.

superseded_clauses: The service fee is taken from the tier's service_fee_ladder band containing the item's net price and is charged only on the claim types in service_fee_claim_types; it is collected before the repair or replacement is released and never reduces liability.
The limit of liability of each item follows liability_limit_basis and every reimbursement follows reimbursement_basis; a TV's screen size is read from the covered line's item description.
